title: Create content review agents and manage approvals directly in the Hightouch Agentic Marketing Platform
summary: Scale content review at the pace of AI generation
body_markdown:
As AI makes it easier to generate more content than ever, review processes need to keep pace. No one wants to accidentally ship an ad that is off-brand or misrepresents their product. In the Hightouch Agentic Marketing Platform, you can review and approve content at scale.


Instead of waiting a few days on multiple rounds of content review, you can configure review agents to scale the first pass. Agents can focus on any topic necessary, including legal, brand, messaging, and product accuracy. One thing many customers (and their compliance teams) love is the ability to create as many review agents as they need and make them as specific as they want.


After agentic review, loop in team members for the final stamp of approval. Similar to any collaboration suite, comment and tag them on the ad, and they will receive an email notification.


With this capability, your team stays in full control, while still benefiting from the scale and velocity that an Agentic Marketing Platform unlocks.


## How it works


Here is an example for how to configure and run a Product Accuracy Review agent.


1.


**Configure the agent in the context hub** Create as many as you want and make them as detailed as necessary


2.


**Run the review agent across selected creative** Choose all of the creative you want to review and select the type of review you would like to run.


3.


**Review the suggestion on each piece of creative and make any necessary changes** The agent’s analysis will appear as a comment. You can use the chat or make manual edits to update the ad.


4.


**Tag in team members for final review** People will receive an email notification asking for their review.
